source_summary.note: The first-run and workbench images use the v26.8.22 Shell renderer with a deterministic Framework contract fixture. They prove the documented UI states without using a real account and are not clean-install acceptance evidence. The focused DMG Finder image is retained from the macOS VM capture because that OS interaction did not change.
